operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Israeli Security Cabinet Authorizes Renewed Gaza Military Campaign; Ceasefire Collapses on Day 942
heroSubtitle: Israel’s security cabinet convened on May 10, 2026 to formally authorize the IDF to resume large-scale military operations in Gaza after Hamas definitively missed the Board of Peace end-of-week disarmament deadline. A senior IDF general had declared renewed war ‘almost inevitable’; the Board of Peace confirmed it would not restrain Israel. Gaza death toll reached 72,736+ killed and 870+ dead since the October 2025 ceasefire. Turkey’s FM Hakan Fidan held emergency Hamas talks in Doha on May 9 that produced no breakthrough. An IDF drone killed Eyad al-Motawwaq near Jabalia on May 9. The October 2025 ceasefire — the longest pause in active combat since the war began — collapsed after 212 days. UN, EU, Turkey, and Arab states issued emergency diplomatic appeals against war resumption with no country threatening concrete consequences against Israel.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, WAFA, Palestine Info, Jerusalem Post, and UN DPPA. Gaza death toll: 72,736+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023 (Gaza MoH / Palestine Info / WAFA, May 9–10, 2026). 870+ killed since Oct 2025 ceasefire as of May 10, 2026. Hamas missed Board of Peace disarmament deadline (May 9–10, 2026); Israeli security cabinet authorized war resumption May 10. IDF drone killed Eyad al-Motawwaq near Jabalia May 9. Turkey FM Fidan met Hamas Shura Council head Darwish in Doha May 9 — no breakthrough. Flotilla activists Saif Abu Keshek (Spain) and Thiago Avila (Brazil) released from Israeli detention. 8,000+ bodies remain under Gaza rubble; only 1 functioning ICRC excavator. Board of Peace $17B+ reconstruction fund frozen pending Hamas disarmament. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, only ~10% funded. Day 942 of war.
